headline: A 2012 executive order created a federal task force to guide rebuilding after Hurricane Sandy.
what_it_does: This order set up the Hurricane Sandy Rebuilding Task Force. Based on the title, the group's job was to organize the federal government's work on rebuilding areas damaged by Hurricane Sandy, which struck the East Coast in late October 2012. No summary was provided, so details such as who led the task force and what powers it had are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities in areas hit by Hurricane Sandy
who_it_affects.how: Federal rebuilding efforts in their areas were to be coordinated through the new task force.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in disaster recovery
who_it_affects.how: They were expected to work with the task force on Sandy rebuilding.
